title: Shounen Ashibe - Goma-chan no Yuuenchi Daibouken
aliases: Shounen Ashibe: Goma-chan no Yuuenchi Daibouken
description: A Super Famicom platformer in which the playable character is a lovable seal creature. The game is based on a 90s slice of life manga and anime about the adventures of a boy (Ashibe) and a seal (Goma-chan).
